purpose.zh: 拉伸臀部，缓解久坐髋部发紧
purpose.en: Stretch your glutes and ease hip tightness from sitting.

text.zh: 一只脚踝搭在另一侧膝盖上，背挺直往前倾
text.en: Cross one ankle over the other knee and lean forward with a long back

text.zh: 支撑脚踩平，翘起的膝盖自然往外打开。
text.en: Keep the other foot flat and let the crossed knee fall open.

text.zh: 保持不动，慢慢呼吸，每次呼气再放松一点。
text.en: Stay still, breathe slowly, and relax a little deeper each time you breathe out.

text.zh: 别来回颠，有拉伸感就够，别拉到疼。
text.en: Do not bounce; a clear stretch is enough, never pain.

commonErrors.en: Rounding the back to go deeper.
Forcing the knee down with your hand.

cautions.zh: 膝盖疼时少往前倾一点，还疼就停
cautions.en: If your knee hurts, lean less, and stop if it still hurts.

changes: 剂量 30 s 保持 → 每侧 2 组×6 次（rep_hold，stretchLoop）
节奏按 spec 时间轴手算（派生值把 90% 以上都算停顿，和 spec 不符）：倾 1.4/停 3.6/回 1.4/歇 1.6 s（派生 1.9/2.4/1.9/1.9）
主口令去掉「对侧」；cue3 补上动画里双手的位置
按用户决定改为静态保持计时，动画只作示意
